evals.prompt: Coordinator and human owner share a repository. evals.expected_output: Recognize that a pathspec commit takes the whole worktree version and reverse-overwrites the index; switch to index surgery: git hash-object -w the content with the owner's lines removed, stage that blob with git update-index --cacheinfo, then run git commit without a pathspec; after committing, git status confirms the owner's lines remain uncommitted in the working tree.
expectations: Understand that git commit -- <path> takes worktree content, bypassing and overwriting any manual staging
Use hash-object plus update-index --cacheinfo to precisely control what enters the commit
The final commit carries no pathspec; the commit tree comes only from the index
After committing, verify the owner's changes remain in the working tree, never swept in
